title: Spotify licence error cleared without software update
summary: Spotify was still failing earlier in the morning but was working normally by about 10:00 with multiple tracks. Wilson remained on factory software 2026.14.300, so no car update coincided with recovery. The issue is now resolved and should simply be monitored for recurrence.

title: Autosteer bend behaviour added for monitoring
summary: Wilson appeared to steer into a bend later than preferred and made alternating corrections during brief non-motorway use. A cautious test on a suitable clearly marked road is recorded before the longer journey.

title: Wilson Hub migrated to a maintainable static project
summary: Structured factual data, validation, responsive navigation, search and personal browser state prepared for GitHub Pages.

title: Three ownership checks remain pending
summary: This earlier snapshot is superseded because the Spotify retest is now complete. The first normal OTA update and Fold 8 wireless-charging stability remain pending.
